**BLOCKER** · `run-blocking-prod` — runBlocking in onCreate blocks the main thread

The main thread waits for the session refresh, so the first frame is late.

**Fix:** Start the refresh in a coroutine.

<!-- acr:v1:run-blocking-prod:app/src/main/java/com/example/sample/MainActivity.kt:f6631c865b8f -->

**BLOCKER** · `global-scope` — prefetch() launches in GlobalScope

The coroutine outlives the screen.

**Fix:** Use a scope tied to the lifecycle.

<!-- acr:v1:global-scope:app/src/main/java/com/example/sample/data/SessionRepository.kt:9617645d09ba -->
